title: Pedir en un restaurante
communication_goal: Leer un menú, pedir comida y bebida y responder preguntas sencillas del camarero.
situation: Comes en un restaurante y haces un pedido con cortesía.

vocabulary.example: The chicken is the main course.
I'd like rice as a side.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes. I'd like the chicken with rice, please.
dialogue.spanish: Sí. Quisiera el pollo con arroz, por favor.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can I have some water, please?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: That's all, thank you. Can we have the bill later?
dialogue.spanish: Eso es todo, gracias. ¿Podemos pedir la cuenta después?

explanation_es: En un restaurante puedes decir I'd like the chicken, please o Can I have some water, please?. El camarero puede preguntar Would you like...? para ofrecer algo. Para terminar el pedido usa That's all, thank you. Para pedir la cuenta, Can we have the bill, please?.
spanish_speaker_notes: Order en restaurante significa pedir, no solo ordenar objetos.
Some water es natural cuando pides una cantidad no específica.
That's all significa 'eso es todo', no 'eso está mal'.
Bill es la cuenta; check puede usarse en algunos lugares, pero bill es una opción clara.

targets.text: I'd like the chicken with rice, please.
targets.focus: I'd like y chicken with rice

targets.text: Can I have some water, please?

pronunciation.tip_es: Usa una entonación amable y una pausa breve al terminar cada pedido.

reading.title: A cafe menu
reading.text: The cafe menu has chicken with rice, vegetable soup and a cheese sandwich. Customers can order water, juice or coffee. After dinner, they can have fruit or cake. The bill is five dollars for each person.

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada palabra del restaurante con su significado.
Escucha: That's all, thank you. Elige cuándo se usa.
activities.feedback: That's all indica que no deseas añadir más.
Water es no contable y una petición usa some.

activities.instruction: Ordena: have / can / bill / the / we / ?
activities.feedback: Can we have formula una petición del grupo.

activities.instruction: Corrige: I like the chicken, please.
activities.feedback: Para pedir en un restaurante usa I'd like.

activities.instruction: Representa un pedido con plato, bebida y cierre.
activities.target: I'd like ... Can I have ...? That's all, thank you.

activities.instruction: Lee A Cafe Menu y responde: What desserts are available?
activities.feedback: La tercera oración menciona los postres.

activities.instruction: La IA será camarero. Lee un menú ficticio, pide un plato, bebida y postre, y responde Would you like...?.
activities.scenario: Ordering a complete meal at a cafe.
activities.ai_language: English; make the menu accessible and realistic

activities.instruction: Graba un diálogo de ocho turnos en un restaurante: pedir menú, plato, bebida, postre y cuenta.
success_criteria: usa I'd like y Can I have

activities.instruction: Completa: Are you ready to ___? I'd ___ the soup. That's ___, thank you. Can we have the ___?

mastery_criteria.retry: Si traduces literalmente el pedido, practica tres veces el bloque I'd like..., please.
